contract: A road user is backing at an observation: it moves in the direction opposite to the one its body points. Measured as the component of its velocity (kin.velocity, m/s, world frame) along its heading (kin.heading, unit vector) lying below the negative of the motion tolerance, the speed below which a sampled motion counts as none. Not a stand-in for the gear selected: a vehicle in reverse gear that stands still or rolls forward is not backing, and one in a forward gear that rolls backwards is.

params.name: motion_tolerance
params.meaning: the speed below which a sampled motion along the heading counts as none

elements.span: the component of its velocity (kin.velocity, m/s, world frame) along its heading (kin.heading, unit vector)
elements.justification: kin.velocity 'velocity vector' and kin.heading 'direction the body points': their product along the heading is negative when the body moves rearward. kin.gear is not read: its contract says it is 'Not a stand-in for: the direction of motion'.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle's velocity points opposite its heading at a speed above the motion tolerance.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle in reverse gear stands still.
